# Amerant Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results


October 22, 2026 4:30 PM EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_608bb6682d1ed24ce8ba6924eb7fb825/amerantbank/news/2026-10-22_Amerant_Reports_Third_Quarter_2026_144.pdf)

[Earnings Presentation](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_608bb6682d1ed24ce8ba6924eb7fb825/amerantbank/db/2288/21668/presentation/MEID+MASTER+Earnings+Deck+%2809.30.2026%29+FINAL.pdf)


[PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_608bb6682d1ed24ce8ba6924eb7fb825/amerantbank/db/2288/21668/presentation/MEID+MASTER+Earnings+Deck+%2809.30.2026%29+FINAL.pdf)


CORAL GABLES, Fla.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Amerant Bancorp Inc. (NYSE: AMTB) (the “Company” or “Amerant”) today reported net income attributable to the Company of $25.7 million in the third quarter of 2026, or $0.65 earnings per diluted share, compared to net income of $21.0 million, or $0.53 earnings per diluted share, in the second quarter of 2026.


"Our third quarter results reflect meaningful progress in building a more profitable and resilient franchise," said Carlos Iafigliola, President and Chief Executive Officer. "Stronger net interest income and disciplined expense management drove improved profitability, net interest margin expansion, and higher net income. We also achieved solid loan growth, continued to reduce non-performing assets and classified loans, and achieved a noninterest bearing deposit mix that better reflects the underlying strength of our deposit base. With a stronger foundation now in place, our focus is increasingly shifting toward enhancing franchise value and delivering sustainable returns for our shareholders."


Below are the results for 3Q26 and their comparison to 2Q26:


- Total assets were $10.2 billion, down by $82.6 million, or 0.8%, compared to $10.3 billion.
- Total gross loans, which include all loans held for sale, were $7.1 billion, up by $207.8 million, or 3.0%, compared to $6.9 billion.
- Cash and cash equivalents and restricted cash were $361.5 million, up by $60.3 million, or 20.0%, compared to $301.1 million.
- Total investments were $2.2 billion, down by $382.8 million, or 14.7%, compared to $2.6 billion.
- Total deposits were $8.2 billion, down by $109.6 million, or 1.3%, compared to $8.4 billion.
- Core deposits were $6.3 billion, down by $125.8 million, or 2.0%, compared to $6.4 billion.
- Total advances from the Federal Home Loan Bank (“FHLB”) were $715.0 million, up by $12.4 million, or 1.8%, compared to $702.6 million.
- Net Interest Margin (“NIM”) was 3.77%, compared to 3.52%. The increase in NIM reflects $1.6 million in additional interest recorded during the quarter from repayments of loans previously in nonaccrual status.
- Average yield on loans was 6.35%, compared to 6.22%.
- Average cost of total deposits was 2.07%, compared to 2.21%.
- Loan to deposit ratio was 85.78%, compared to 82.17%.
- Asset Quality and Allowance for Credit Losses (“ACL”):


- Total non-performing assets were $159.5 million, down by $27.1 million, or 14.5%, compared to $186.6 million. As of 3Q26, non-performing assets consist of $149.5 million in non-performing loans and $10.0 million in Other Real Estate Owned (“OREO”).
- The ACL was $94.8 million compared to $85.5 million.
- Classified loans were $213.0 million, down by $60.1 million, or 22.0%, compared to $273.1 million, while non-performing loans were $149.5 million, down $21.6 million, or 12.6%, compared to $171.1 million. The reduction in classified and non-performing loans was primarily attributable to payoffs during the quarter. Special mention loans were $120.7 million, up $10.9 million, or 10.0%, compared to $109.8 million. The increase was primarily driven by downgrades during the quarter.
- The Company has provided additional details regarding asset quality in the 3Q26 earnings presentation ([https://investor.amerantbank.com](https://investor.amerantbank.com/) ).


- Assets Under Management and custody (“AUM”) totaled $3.45 billion, up by $77.9 million, or 2.3% from $3.37 billion.
- Pre-tax pre-provision net revenue (“PPNR”)(1) was $39.7 million, up by $7.8 million, or 24.6%, compared to PPNR of $31.9 million.
- Net Interest Income (“NII”) was $90.5 million, up by $7.9 million, or 9.6%, from $82.6 million.
- Provision for credit losses was $6.2 million, up by $1.5 million, or 30.5%, compared to $4.8 million.
- Noninterest income was $18.3 million, up by $0.2 million, or 1.0%, from $18.2 million.
- Noninterest expense was $69.1 million, up by $0.2 million, or 0.3%, from $68.9 million. Noninterest expense this quarter includes $1.3 million in OREO income, compared to $0.3 million in the previous quarter.
- The efficiency ratio was 63.51%, compared to 68.37%.
- Return on average assets (“ROA”) was 1.00%, compared to 0.84%.
- Return on average equity (“ROE”) was 11.29%, compared to 9.23%.
- The Company repurchased an aggregate of 70,592 shares of Class A common stock at a weighted average price of $28.47 per share, or 1.36x of Tangible Book Value ("TBV")(1) and 1.32x of book value per share. The aggregate purchase price for these transactions was approximately $2.0 million.
- On September 17, 2026, the Company completed a registered offering of $50.0 million aggregate principal amount of 7.00% Senior Notes due 2031. The unsecured, unsubordinated Notes bear interest at 7.00% per annum, payable semi-annually beginning March 17, 2027, rank pari passu with the Company's other unsecured and unsubordinated indebtedness, and rank senior to subordinated indebtedness.
- On October 21, 2026, the Company’s Board of Directors declared a cash dividend of $0.09 per share of common stock. The dividend is payable on November 27, 2026 to shareholders of record on November 13, 2026.


Additional details on the third quarter 2026 results can be found in the Exhibits and Glossary of Terms and Definitions to this earnings release, and the earnings presentation available under the Investor Relations section of the Company’s website at[https://investor.amerantbank.com](https://investor.amerantbank.com/) . See Glossary of Terms and Definitions for definitions of financial terms.


1 Non-GAAP measure, see “Non-GAAP Financial Measures” for more information and Exhibit 2 for a reconciliation to GAAP measures.


**Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call**


The Company will hold an earnings conference call on Friday, October 23, 2026 at 9:00 a.m. (Eastern Time) to discuss its third quarter 2026 results. The conference call and presentation materials can be accessed via webcast by logging on from the Investor Relations section of the Company’s website at[https://investor.amerantbank.com](https://investor.amerantbank.com/) . The online replay will remain available for approximately one month following the call through the above link.


**About Amerant Bancorp Inc. (NYSE: AMTB)**


Amerant Bancorp Inc. is a bank holding company headquartered in Coral Gables, Florida since 1979. The Company operates through its main subsidiary, Amerant Bank, N.A. (the “Bank”), as well as its other subsidiary Amerant Investments, Inc. The Company provides individuals and businesses with deposit, credit and wealth management services. The Bank, which has operated for over 45 years, is headquartered in Florida and has a network of 23 banking centers – 21 in South Florida and 2 in Tampa, Florida. For more information, visit investor.amerantbank.com.

**Interim Financial Information**


Unaudited financial information as of and for interim periods, including the three and nine month periods ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, and the three month periods ended June 30, 2026, March 31, 2026, and December 31, 2025, may not reflect our results of operations for our fiscal year ending, or financial condition, as of December 31, 2026, or any other period of time or date.


**Non-GAAP Financial Measures**


The Company supplements its financial results that are determined in accordance with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States of America (“GAAP”) with non-GAAP financial measures, such as “pre-tax pre-provision net revenue (PPNR)”, "tangible common equity ratio", and “tangible stockholders’ equity (book value) per common share”. This supplemental information is not required by, or is not presented in accordance with GAAP. The Company refers to these financial measures and ratios as “non-GAAP financial measures”.


We use certain non-GAAP financial measures, including those mentioned above, both to explain our results to shareholders and the investment community and in the internal evaluation and management of our business. Management believes that these supplementary non-GAAP financial measures and the information they provide are useful to investors since these measures permit investors to view our performance using the same tools that our management uses to evaluate our past performance and prospects for future performance. While we believe that these non-GAAP financial measures are useful in evaluating our performance, this information should be considered as supplemental and not as a substitute for or superior to the related financial information prepared in accordance with GAAP. Additionally, these non-GAAP financial measures may differ from similar measures presented by other companies.


Exhibit 2 reconciles these non-GAAP financial measures to GAAP reported results.


Beginning in the first quarter of 2026, the Company reviewed and updated its use of non‑GAAP financial measures and now presents a limited set of metrics that management uses to evaluate performance and make operating decisions. As part of this update, the Company discontinued the presentation of “Core PPNR”, “core noninterest income”, “core noninterest expense”, “core net income”, “core earnings per share (basic and diluted)”, “core return on assets (Core ROA)”, “core return on equity (Core ROE)”, and “core efficiency ratio” as management determined these measures are no longer primary metrics used internally. This change does not reflect any change in the Company’s underlying business, operations, or GAAP financial results.

**Glossary of Terms and Definitions**


- Assets under management and custody: consists of assets held for clients in an agency or fiduciary capacity which are not assets of the Company and therefore are not included in the consolidated financial statements.
- Classified loans: consist of loans that have been adversely classified due to credit risk and are categorized as substandard and doubtful.
- Common equity tier 1 capital ratio, CET1: Tier 1 capital divided by total risk-weighted assets.
- Core deposits: consist of total deposits excluding all time deposits.
- Cost of total deposits: calculated based upon the average balance of total noninterest bearing and interest bearing deposits, which includes time deposits.
- Efficiency ratio: total noninterest expense divided by the sum of noninterest income and NII.
- FTEs: full-time equivalent employees
- Loans to Deposits ratio: calculated as the ratio of total gross loans divided by total deposits.
- Net interest margin, or NIM: defined as net interest income, or NII, divided by average interest-earning assets, which are loans, securities, deposits with banks and other financial assets which yield interest or similar income.
- Non-performing assets include all accruing loans past due by 90 days or more, all nonaccrual loans and other real estate owned (“OREO”) properties acquired through or in lieu of foreclosure, and other repossessed assets.
- Non-performing loans include all accruing loans past due by 90 days or more and all nonaccrual loans.
- Other operating expenses: total noninterest expense less salary and employee benefits.
- Ratio for net charge-offs/average total loans held for investment: calculated based upon the average daily balance of outstanding loan principal balance net of unamortized deferred loan origination fees and costs, excluding the allowance for credit losses.
- ROA is calculated based upon the average daily balance of total assets.
- ROE is calculated based upon the average daily balance of stockholders’ equity.
- Tangible common equity ratio: calculated as the ratio of common equity less goodwill and other intangibles divided by total assets less goodwill and other intangible assets. Other intangible assets primarily consist of naming rights and mortgage servicing rights and are included in other assets in the Company’s consolidated balance sheets.
- The terms of the FHLB advance agreements require the Bank to maintain certain investment securities or loans as collateral for these advances.
- Tier 1 capital: Tier 1 capital is composed of Common Equity Tier 1 (CET1) capital plus outstanding qualifying trust preferred securities of $62.3 million at each of the dates presented.
- Tier 1 leverage ratio: Tier 1 capital divided by quarter to date average assets.
- Total capital ratio: total qualifying regulatory stockholders’ equity divided by total risk-weighted assets, calculated according to the standardized regulatory capital ratio calculations.
- Total gross loans: consists of the principal balance of outstanding loans, including loans held for investment, loans held for sale at the lower of cost or fair value, and mortgage loans held for sale, net of unamortized deferred nonrefundable loan origination fees and loan origination costs, unamortized premiums paid on purchased loans and the unamortized balance of initial allowance for credit losses on purchased seasoned loans.
- Total revenue is the result of net interest income before provision for credit losses plus noninterest income.
